Title: Buttons (with buttonholes)
Blurb: Functional buttons with buttonholes for fastening clothing first appear in Germany.

Title: Hand cannon
Blurb: Earliest hand cannon, from a Heilongjiang excavation under the Yuan dynasty.

Title: Mechanical escapement (verge escapement)
Blurb: Earliest mechanical escapement appears in Europe, enabling mechanical clocks.

Title: Double-entry bookkeeping
Blurb: Double-entry bookkeeping develops in Italy, foundational to modern accounting.

Title: Worm gear cotton gin
Blurb: Worm-gear roller cotton gin developed in India.

Title: Rocket
Blurb: Rockets for military and recreational use date to at least 13th-century China.

Title: Snow goggles
Blurb: Inuit snow goggles of ivory, the earliest documented sunglasses, in Arctic North America.

Title: Explosive bomb
Blurb: Cast-iron 'thunder-crash' explosive bombs used by the Jin dynasty (from 1221).

Title: Land mine
Blurb: First recorded land mine, used by Song general Lou Qianxia against Mongols at Guangxi.

Title: Eyeglasses
Blurb: Eyeglasses invented in Italy.

Title: Jacob's staff
Blurb: Jacob's staff (cross-staff) for measuring angles, described by Levi ben Gerson.

Title: Huolongchushui (multistage rocket)
Blurb: Huolongchushui, the first multistage rocket, developed in Ming China.

Title: Painting canvas
Blurb: Canvas first used as a painting support in Italy.

Title: Bidriware
Blurb: Bidriware metal handicraft develops in the Bahmani Sultanate, India.

Title: Naval mine
Blurb: Naval mines described in the Huolongjing military manual, Ming China.

Title: Handgun (first use)
Blurb: First recorded use of a handgun.

Title: Coil spring
Blurb: Coil spring appears in Europe.

Title: Arquebus
Blurb: The arquebus, an early long gun, is invented (possibly in Spain).

Title: Mainspring
Blurb: Mainspring in Europe enables portable spring-driven clocks and watches.

Title: Brace (tool)
Blurb: Carpenter's brace (boring tool) in Flanders, Holy Roman Empire.

Title: Printing press
Blurb: Gutenberg's movable-type printing press in Mainz, transforming the spread of knowledge.

Title: Liquation
Blurb: First large-scale liquation to separate silver from silver-bearing copper, Nuremberg.

Title: Mariner's astrolabe
Blurb: Mariner's astrolabe used in Portuguese ocean navigation.

Title: Hookah
Blurb: The hookah appears at the court of Mughal emperor Akbar I.

Title: Chintz (printed cotton)
Blurb: Printed/painted chintz cotton textiles develop in Golconda, India.

Title: Rifling
Blurb: Rifling first used in firearms, greatly improving accuracy.

Title: Floating dry dock
Blurb: Floating dry dock developed in Venice, Venetian Republic.

Title: Mercator projection
Blurb: Gerardus Mercator publishes his cylindrical map projection for navigation.

Title: Stocking frame
Blurb: William Lee invents the stocking frame knitting machine in England.

Title: Backstaff
Blurb: Captain John Davis invents the backstaff for measuring solar altitude at sea.

Title: Newspaper (Relation)
Blurb: Johann Carolus publishes the Relation in Strasbourg, the world's first newspaper.

Title: Telescope
Blurb: Hans Lippershey applies for a patent for the telescope in the Netherlands.

Title: Compound microscope
Blurb: Compound microscopes combining objective and eyepiece first appear in Europe.

Title: Flintlock
Blurb: First use of the flintlock firing mechanism, in France.

Title: Slide rule
Blurb: William Oughtred invents the slide rule.

Title: Mechanical calculator (Pascaline)
Blurb: Blaise Pascal builds the Pascaline mechanical calculator in Paris.

Title: Barometer
Blurb: Evangelista Torricelli invents the mercury barometer in Italy.

Title: Vacuum pump
Blurb: Otto von Guericke invents the vacuum pump in Magdeburg.

Title: Pendulum clock
Blurb: Christiaan Huygens invents the pendulum clock, greatly improving timekeeping.

Title: Reflecting telescope
Blurb: Isaac Newton constructs the first functional reflecting telescope.

Title: Pressure cooker
Blurb: Denis Papin invents the pressure cooker (steam digester).

Title: Piston engine (first description)
Blurb: Christiaan Huygens gives the first known description of a piston engine.

Title: Steam-powered water pump
Blurb: Thomas Savery develops a steam-powered pump for draining mines.

Title: Piano
Blurb: Bartolomeo Cristofori crafts the first piano, later a leading Western instrument.

Title: Commercial steam engine (Newcomen)
Blurb: Thomas Newcomen builds the first commercial steam engine to pump water from mines.

Title: Mechanized cotton spinning machine
Blurb: Lewis Paul and John Wyatt invent the first mechanized cotton spinning machine.

Title: Leyden jar
Blurb: Musschenbroek and von Kleist develop the Leyden jar, an early capacitor.

Title: Lead chamber process
Blurb: John Roebuck invents the lead chamber process for mass-producing sulfuric acid.

Title: Artificial refrigeration
Blurb: William Cullen demonstrates the first artificial refrigeration machine.

Title: Spinning jenny
Blurb: James Hargreaves invents the spinning jenny, transforming textile production.

Title: Steam-powered vehicle
Blurb: Nicolas-Joseph Cugnot builds the first steam-powered passenger vehicle.

Title: Boring machine
Blurb: John Wilkinson invents his cylinder-boring machine, an early machine tool.

Title: Screw-cutting lathe
Blurb: Jesse Ramsden invents the modern screw-cutting lathe.

Title: Mechanical air compressor
Blurb: John Wilkinson invents a mechanical air compressor, prototype for later compressors.

Title: Metal-cylinder rockets (Mysorean)
Blurb: Hyder Ali of Mysore develops the first iron-cased Mysorean rockets.

Title: Hot air balloon
Blurb: The Montgolfier brothers build the first manned hot air balloon.

Title: Steamboat
Blurb: Claude de Jouffroy builds the first steamboat.

Title: Parachute
Blurb: Louis-Sebastien Lenormand invents and uses the first modern parachute.

Title: Electrolysis
Blurb: Martinus van Marum is the first to use the electrolysis technique.

Title: Threshing machine
Blurb: Andrew Meikle invents the threshing machine.

Title: Power loom
Blurb: Edmund Cartwright invents the power loom, mechanizing weaving.

Title: Semaphore telegraph
Blurb: Claude Chappe invents the semaphore (optical) telegraph.

Title: Modern cotton gin
Blurb: Eli Whitney invents the modern cotton gin, reshaping the US cotton economy.

Title: Hydraulic press
Blurb: Joseph Bramah invents the hydraulic press.

Title: Vaccine (smallpox)
Blurb: Edward Jenner develops the smallpox vaccine, founding immunization.

Title: Lithography
Blurb: Alois Senefelder invents the lithography printing technique.

Title: Paper machine
Blurb: Louis-Nicolas Robert invents the first continuous paper machine.

Title: Voltaic pile (battery)
Blurb: Alessandro Volta invents the voltaic pile, an early electric battery, in Italy.

Title: Arc lamp
Blurb: Humphry Davy demonstrates the electric arc lamp.

Title: Steam locomotive
Blurb: Richard Trevithick invents the steam locomotive.

Title: Jacquard loom
Blurb: Joseph Marie Jacquard develops his punch-card automated loom.

Title: Morphine
Blurb: Friedrich Serturner isolates morphine, the first alkaloid from opium.

Title: General anesthetic (tsusensan)
Blurb: Hanaoka Seishu creates tsusensan, the first modern general anesthetic.

Title: Internal combustion engine (early)
Blurb: Nicephore Niepce invents an early internal combustion engine (the Pyreolophore).

Title: Workable steamboat
Blurb: Robert Fulton expands water transport with the first commercially workable steamboat.

Title: Hydrogen ICE automobile
Blurb: Francois Isaac de Rivaz designs the first automobile powered by an internal combustion engine.

Title: Canning (food preservation)
Blurb: Nicolas Appert invents the canning process for preserving food.

Title: Wristwatch
Blurb: Abraham-Louis Breguet creates the first wristwatch.

Title: Powered printing press
Blurb: Friedrich Koenig invents the first steam-powered cylinder printing press.

Title: Safety lamp
Blurb: William Reid Clanny pioneers the miner's safety lamp.

Title: Planing machine
Blurb: James Fox invents the modern metal planing machine.

Title: Electric telegraph (electrostatic)
Blurb: Francis Ronalds builds the first working electric telegraph.

Title: Stirling engine
Blurb: Robert Stirling invents the Stirling engine.

Title: Stethoscope
Blurb: Rene Laennec invents the first stethoscope.

Title: Dandy horse (velocipede)
Blurb: Karl von Drais invents the dandy horse, precursor to the bicycle.

Title: Tunnelling shield
Blurb: Marc Isambard Brunel invents the tunnelling shield for underwater tunneling.

Title: Heliography (photography)
Blurb: Nicephore Niepce invents heliography, the first photographic process.

Title: Pattern-tracing lathe
Blurb: Thomas Blanchard invents the pattern-tracing lathe for copying irregular shapes.

Title: Programmable mechanical computer
Blurb: Charles Babbage begins building the first programmable mechanical computer.

Title: Lighter (Dobereiner's lamp)
Blurb: Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner invents the first lighter.

Title: Bolt-action rifle
Blurb: Johann Nikolaus von Dreyse invents the bolt-action rifle.

Title: Electromagnet
Blurb: William Sturgeon invents the electromagnet.

Title: Gas stove
Blurb: James Sharp invents and manufactures the first practical gas stove.

Title: Friction match
Blurb: John Walker invents the friction match.

Title: Commutated rotary electromechanical machine
Blurb: Anyos Jedlik invents the first commutated rotary electromechanical machine with electromagnets.

Title: Hot blast process
Blurb: James Beaumont Neilson develops the hot blast process for iron smelting.

Title: Reaping machine
Blurb: Patrick Bell invents the reaping machine.

Title: Corrugated galvanised iron
Blurb: Henry Robinson Palmer is awarded a patent for corrugated galvanised iron.

Title: Braille
Blurb: Louis Braille invents the Braille reading system for the blind.

Title: Compound air compressor
Blurb: William Mann invents the compound air compressor.

Title: Lawn mower
Blurb: Edwin Budding invents the lawn mower.

Title: Electromagnetic induction & generator
Blurb: Michael Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction and builds the first electric generator.

Title: Mechanical calculating machine (Analytical Engine)
Blurb: Charles Babbage introduces his mechanical calculating machine design.

Title: Practical electric motor
Blurb: Moritz von Jacobi invents the first practical electric motor.

Title: Electromechanical relay
Blurb: Joseph Henry invents the electromechanical relay.

Title: Morse code
Blurb: Samuel Morse invents Morse code.

Title: Electrotyping
Blurb: Moritz von Jacobi invents electrotyping.

Title: Daguerreotype photography
Blurb: Louis Daguerre invents daguerreotype photography.

Title: Bicycle (pedal-driven)
Blurb: Kirkpatrick Macmillan invents the first pedal-driven bicycle.

Title: Vulcanized rubber
Blurb: Charles Goodyear invents vulcanized rubber.

Title: Steam shovel
Blurb: William Otis invents the steam shovel.

Title: Steam hammer
Blurb: James Nasmyth invents the steam hammer.

Title: Photovoltaic effect (solar cell)
Blurb: Edmond Becquerel discovers the photovoltaic effect, producing the first solar cell.

Title: Blueprint
Blurb: John Herschel invents the blueprint reproduction process.

Title: Printing telegraph
Blurb: Alexander Bain devises a printing telegraph.

Title: Superphosphate fertilizer
Blurb: John Bennet Lawes invents superphosphate, the first man-made fertilizer.

Title: Fuel cell
Blurb: William Robert Grove invents the first fuel cell.

Title: Wood pulp paper
Blurb: Friedrich Gottlob Keller and Charles Fenerty develop wood pulp paper production.

Title: Nitrous oxide anesthesia
Blurb: Horace Wells successfully uses nitrous oxide as an anesthetic.

Title: Hypodermic needle
Blurb: Francis Rynd invents the hypodermic needle.

Title: Modern Portland cement
Blurb: Isaac Charles Johnson invents modern Portland cement.

Title: Sewing machine
Blurb: Elias Howe patents a sewing machine, the model for the Singer machine.

Title: Tunnel boring machine
Blurb: Henri-Joseph Maus invents the tunnel boring machine.

Title: Nitroglycerin
Blurb: Ascanio Sobrero invents nitroglycerin, the first explosive stronger than black powder.

Title: Pneumatic drill
Blurb: Jonathan J. Couch invents the pneumatic drill.

Title: Modern pin tumbler lock
Blurb: Linus Yale Sr. invents the first modern pin tumbler lock.

Title: Francis turbine
Blurb: James B. Francis invents the Francis turbine.

Title: Safety pin
Blurb: Walter Hunt invents the safety pin.

Title: Repeating rifle (metallic cartridge)
Blurb: Walter Hunt invents the first repeating rifle using metallic cartridges.

Title: Hydraulic accumulator
Blurb: William Armstrong invents the hydraulic accumulator, storing pressurized water to power machinery.

Title: Public flush toilet
Blurb: George Jennings offers the first public flush toilets and patents the modern water closet.

Title: Chemical vapor deposition
Blurb: Robert Bunsen is the first to use a chemical vapor deposition technique.

Title: Safety elevator
Blurb: Elisha Otis invents the safety brake elevator, enabling tall buildings.

Title: Powered dirigible flight
Blurb: Henri Giffard makes the first manned, controlled, powered flight using a dirigible.

Title: Reinforced concrete
Blurb: Francois Coignet invents reinforced concrete, embedding iron to strengthen concrete.

Title: Color photography
Blurb: James Clerk Maxwell demonstrates the first practical method for color photography.

Title: Bessemer process
Blurb: Henry Bessemer patents the Bessemer process for mass-producing steel.

Title: Ice-making machine
Blurb: James Harrison produces the first practical vapour-compression ice-making machine and refrigerator.

Title: Mauveine (first synthetic dye)
Blurb: William Henry Perkin invents mauveine, the first synthetic organic dye.

Title: Parkesine (first plastic)
Blurb: Alexander Parkes invents Parkesine (celluloid), the first man-made plastic.

Title: Phonautograph
Blurb: Edouard-Leon Scott de Martinville patents the phonautograph, the earliest sound-recording device.

Title: Geissler tube
Blurb: Heinrich Geissler invents the Geissler tube, an early gas-discharge tube.

Title: Lead-acid battery
Blurb: Gaston Plante invents the lead-acid battery, the first rechargeable battery.

Title: Carbon fibers
Blurb: Joseph Swan produces carbon fibers while developing incandescent lamp filaments.

Title: Gatling gun
Blurb: Richard Jordan Gatling invents the Gatling gun, the first multi-barrel rapid-fire gun.

Title: Pasteurization
Blurb: Louis Pasteur invents the pasteurization process for preserving food and drink.

Title: Siemens-Martin process
Blurb: Carl Wilhelm Siemens and Pierre-Emile Martin invent the open-hearth process for making steel.

Title: Dynamite
Blurb: Alfred Nobel invents dynamite, the first safely manageable explosive stronger than black powder.

Title: Barbed wire
Blurb: Lucien B. Smith invents barbed wire, transforming fencing and land enclosure.

Title: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
Blurb: Eugen Baumann synthesizes polyvinyl chloride (PVC), commonly known as vinyl.

Title: Stainless steel
Blurb: J. E. T. Woods and J. Clark invent stainless steel; later commercialized by Harry Brearley.
